# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

[ Explore the portfolio ][65]
[Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch representing adhesives and coatings
solutions for flexible materials.] Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch
representing adhesives and coatings solutions for flexible materials.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

[ Discover the innovation ][66]

glowing edge highlighting the packaging.] A person holding an open plastic food container filled
with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.

the world. By supporting community organizations and local partners, the programme helps bring

creating lasting positive change where it matters most.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

## [Florida Woodpeckers: Photos & Identification Guide to Common Species][65]

May 30, 2026
[ [Florida Woodpeckers][Florida Woodpeckers] ][66]

Florida Woodpeckers play an important role in the Sunshine state’s forest ecosystems by controlling
populations of insects that can damage trees, including beetles, ants, and other wood-boring pests.

The nesting cavities excavated by woodpeckers also provide shelter for many other wildlife species,
such as owls, bluebirds, squirrels, and bats, making woodpeckers valuable contributors to forest
biodiversity.

This guide highlights key woodpecker species commonly found in Florida, including the Downy
Woodpecker, Hairy Woodpecker, Ivory-billed Woodpecker, Northern Flicker, Pileated Woodpecker,
Red-bellied Woodpecker, Red-cockaded Woodpecker, Red-headed Woodpecker, and Yellow-bellied
Sapsucker.

Each species is described with a focus on identification features and natural history to assist
birdwatchers and naturalists in recognizing these birds in the field.

[Read more][67]

Categories [Animal Lists][68], [Birds][69]

biodiversity.

## Independent R&D and Deep Customization

Backed by our own R&D center and university partnerships, we tailor hot melt adhesives to your
unique production needs.
 

## Rigorous Quality Control

ISO 9001 & IATF 16949 certified, we ensure batch-to-batch consistency with automated testing
(softening point, viscosity) and traceable production data.

## Full-Process Technical Support

From pre-sales formulation advice to on-site commissioning, our engineers provide 24/7 rapid
response to keep your line running.

## Global Supply Reliability

With a Karamay raw material base and 15+ years of export experience, we deliver stable supply to 30+
countries, compliant with EU REACH/ROHS.
Tailored Service
* Customization Services
  Core Competency: SBC-Based Hot Melt Adhesives
   
  We specialize in engineering Styrenic Block Copolymer (SBC) based hot melt adhesives. Whether your
  application requires the elasticity of SIS or the strength of SBS, we precisely tailor the polymer
  blend to balance adhesion and cohesion for your specific material.
* Value-Added Services
  Beyond the Drum: Technical Partnership
   
  Leveraging our focused R&D on styrenic polymers, we can quickly provide lab samples that mimic
  your production conditions, reducing your testing time and speeding up the approval process.

access and can visit as many times as you like!  There’s something for everyone here. Come for a

enjoy early entry, discounts on programs and in shops and restaurants, and free parking!

and nurse from her mom, Bibi. The Zoo’s care team had to step in and figure out how to feed her,
what to feed her, how to keep her warm, and how to manage critical care 24/7 while juggling other
daily responsibilities.

плюс. Пойдём от толерантности к острому опьянению до перенастройки контура страха при ПТСР и
торможения болезни Альцгеймера.

Это не пропаганда: к каждому плюсу прилагаем контр-факт, потому что взгляд именно неоднозначный.

многовековая традиция начала исчезать буквально на наших глазах.

## [Greene Co. Tenn. Flat back cupboard][12]

####  This is how the cupboard looked when I first saw it in the back of an antique shop. The owner
#### wanted me to restore the piece. It had several coats of paint on it. The feet had half rotted
#### off, the crown molding was missing as were the doors, and the cupboard had been sawed into. The
#### ends were originally one board. To strip it took 40 hours, three gallons of stripper, and three
#### gallons of Acetone. When I had it stripped down to bare wood I realized that some time in the
#### past that it had been refinished with a belt sander. The original wood surface with patina was
#### Gone. Had I known this I would have taken it to someone that had a stripping tank. This is only
#### the second antique that I have ever had to sand out because of the course belt sanding marks
#### left on it.


[ [IMG_4857] ][13]
[ [IMG_4880] ][14]

### The mate to this cupboard can be found  on page 188 Fig. 232 in the book “Art and Mystery of
### Tennessee Furniture”.  That one was made out of walnut and is dated to 1790 – 1820. This one is
### made out of cherry but they were both made in the same shop.

###  I used old lumber to restore this with. I restored the bracket foot base, made new doors, and
### crown molding. The total time to restore this piece was 138 hours.

## [Fireplace Mantel][19]

This is a style that I have not worked in very much. A friend had been on to me for a couple of
years to build a mantel for him. When he showed me a picture of this I fell in love with it. I found
some curly red oak for this project. The back board is curly English brown oak. The fans on the
pilasters are chemically stained. I used a lock miter to build the pilasters. I spent a lot of time
turning the boards over and end for end to get the best reflection out of this curly oak. It took
150 hours to build this mantel.

## [Pediment for Tall Case Clock][35]

 

This tall case clock was missing the pediment on top of the bonnet. The client had found a brass
cherub that he wanted included into the new pediment. The challenge was to design a pediment to
match and flow with the existing moldings and carving of the clock. When I finished and sat the
pediment in place the client, a clock repairman , and I stood there in amazement because all three
of us saw how well it matched the rest of the clock. This pediment took 57 hours to complete.

## [Kitchen Island Worktable][39]

This is a recently finished commission in cherry. The clients wanted a worktable in their kitchen.
Also they wanted saw marks to show and sapwood left in the boards.  I ask him to come over when I
was planing to tell me when to stop so he could have the saw marks left. The cleats on the top or as
some call them breadboard ends have four deep tenons into the cleats. The tenons are dead tight in
thickness and are only glued on the inside of the center tenons. In width the sides of the tenons
are cut loose to allow for expansion and contraction . The dimensions are: Height 36″, Width 72″,
Depth 28″. This commission took 90 hours to complete.    [[005]][40][[001]][41]

ago. I’m blessed in that I absolutely love what I do in life and where I live. Wood is a material
that is very unique not only in it’s grain, color, and texture but it is an organic material with
a soul or spirit to it. To the Daoist everything has Qi which is the life force. Even after the wood
is cut there is still Qi in it. When working with the wood my Qi and the wood’s Qi mingle in a dance
that that is really extraordinary in the results. The most visible of which is beauty , harmony ,and
proportions. These are the basics of classical art and architecture which are derived from nature.
My first shop was in Knoxville, Tenn. . It was small 600 sq.ft. you didn’t have room for two cat to
dance in that shop. But some pretty amazing pieces of furniture and work came out of that wee shop.

# Harmonized System Codes • Schedule B • Harmonized Commodity Description

## What are HS codes?

HS codes are product classification numbers used in international trade. The Harmonized System is
maintained by the World Customs Organization and is used by customs authorities, importers,
exporters, freight forwarders, and trade compliance teams to describe goods in a consistent way.

An HS code usually starts with a 6-digit international classification. Countries often add more
digits for their own tariff schedules, statistical reporting, duty rates, and import or export
controls. In the United States, import classifications are commonly listed as HTS codes and export
classifications are commonly listed as Schedule B codes.

### What they are used for

HS codes help identify the product being shipped, estimate customs duty, prepare import and export
documents, compare tariff treatment, and check whether special trade programs may apply.

### How to search

Search by a code such as [85371090][2], by a formatted code such as [3926.90][3], or by a product
description such as [control panels][4], [plastic boxes][5], [valves][6], [printed books][7],
[medical instruments][8], or [aluminum structures][9].

### Before shipment

Tariff classifications and duty rates can change. Use this lookup as a research starting point, then
verify the final classification with the current official tariff schedule, a customs broker, or the
relevant customs authority.

### Browse common HS code chapters

[Chapter 39 - Plastics][10] [Chapter 73 - Iron or steel articles][11] [Chapter 84 - Machinery][12]
[Chapter 85 - Electrical machinery][13] [Chapter 90 - Measuring and medical instruments][14]
[Chapter 94 - Furniture and lighting][15]

# Harmonized System Codes • Schedule B • Harmonized Commodity Description

## What are HS codes?

HS codes are product classification numbers used in international trade. The Harmonized System is
maintained by the World Customs Organization and is used by customs authorities, importers,
exporters, freight forwarders, and trade compliance teams to describe goods in a consistent way.

An HS code usually starts with a 6-digit international classification. Countries often add more
digits for their own tariff schedules, statistical reporting, duty rates, and import or export
controls. In the United States, import classifications are commonly listed as HTS codes and export
classifications are commonly listed as Schedule B codes.

### What they are used for

HS codes help identify the product being shipped, estimate customs duty, prepare import and export
documents, compare tariff treatment, and check whether special trade programs may apply.

### How to search

Search by a code such as [85371090][2], by a formatted code such as [3926.90][3], or by a product
description such as [control panels][4], [plastic boxes][5], [valves][6], [printed books][7],
[medical instruments][8], or [aluminum structures][9].

### Before shipment

Tariff classifications and duty rates can change. Use this lookup as a research starting point, then
verify the final classification with the current official tariff schedule, a customs broker, or the
relevant customs authority.

[Chapter 85 - Electrical machinery][13] [Chapter 90 - Measuring and medical instruments][14]
[Chapter 94 - Furniture and lighting][15]

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Introducing TRVST

Hello. Thank you for stopping by. At TRVST we’re working to champion change makers, their stories
and inspire collective action for positive change. We believe that by helping to join the dots
between people with the passion to make a difference and the resources required to achieve the
outcomes that matter we can all help to address many of the big issues of our time.

From [climate change][64], [plastic pollution][65], [zero waste][66] through [sustainable
fashion][67] & [equality][68]. And looking after ourselves and each other. There’s a lot our
individual contributions summed can achieve. 

Behind the scenes, we’ve big plans to build technology to help make all this happen. Meanwhile,
we’re busy sharing content to inspire the future we want to see. Enjoy, have a click around and hit
the sign up button below for occasional updates.

The Virtual Learning Series, sponsored by Principal Financial Group and powered by the WIM Education
Foundation, offers monthly webinars on professional development topics that are accessible from
anywhere.

members and $35 for nonmembers.

Our online store just got a refresh, featuring updated merch with the new WIM logo. From drinkware
and ball caps to polo shirts and 1/4 zips, there’s something for every style. It’s an easy way to
represent WIM wherever you go, whether you’re on the shop floor, at a chapter event or out and
about. Take a look and find your new favorite piece.

## Who We Are

The Women in Manufacturing Association (WIM) is a national and global trade association dedicated to
supporting, promoting and inspiring women in the manufacturing industry.  WIM represents
manufacturers of all types and welcomes individuals at every stage of their career—from the shop
floor to the C-suite. Membership is open to anyone working in or with the manufacturing sector,
building a strong and inclusive community that advances women and strengthens the industry.

##### Virtual Learning Series

The Virtual Learning Series, sponsored by Principal Financial Group and powered by the WIM Education
Foundation, offers monthly webinars on professional development topics that are accessible from
anywhere. 

Registration is open for our August webinar. All Virtual Learning Series webinars are free for WIM
members and $35 for nonmembers.


[learn more ][124]

##### New Look, New Gear


Our online store just got a refresh, featuring updated merch with the new WIM logo. From drinkware
and ball caps to polo shirts and 1/4 zips, there’s something for every style. It’s an easy way to
represent WIM wherever you go, whether you’re on the shop floor, at a chapter event or out and
about. Take a look and find your new favorite piece.
